entries.note: The published Table VIII reproduces EXACTLY from the interpolated in-pool column (Tent 0.020074/0.138021/0.020074; EATA 0.039280/0.041667/0.042426; SAR 0.041016/0.000217/0.065430 with seed-0 FA_u = 1/9 = 0.1111, which is the '0.11' the table prints). STRUCTURAL NOTE: at n=9, k = min(9, ceil(10*0.9)) = 9, so eps is the MAXIMUM residual and FA_u is forced to 0 under the exact-rank rule -- the exact-rank column of this table carries no information.

entries.note: CONFIRMS the chief reviewer: exact-rank ceiling 0.097222 at n=432 and 0.037037 at n=27, both BELOW alpha=0.10, so FA_u <= alpha cannot be violated on the stress grids.
